summary: Audited physics.py (3D RK4 force model + Magnus + 2D force layer) against physics.md / PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §2 / SIMULATION_2D_PHYSICS.md. 3D layer is CORRECT: gravity F_g=(0,-mg,0), drag F_d=-0.5*rho*C_d*A*|v|*v, Magnus F_M=0.5*rho*A*C_L0*R*(omega x v) (backspin omega=(0,0,+rate) gives +y lift); constants G/RHO_AIR/C_D/C_L0/BALL_MASS/BALL_RADIUS all match docs; rk4_step vs rk4_step_batch and acceleration vs acceleration_batch are bit-identical (max diff 0.0); release_velocity/spin_vector trig + deg/rad correct; RK4 zero-drag parabola matches analytic x=vx*t to 4e-4 m; pure-drag run loses energy monotonically; backspin(+23) range 5.9135 > plain 5.7702 > topspin 5.6140. FIXED two degenerate-input defects (both ZeroDivisionError/silent-NaN-adjacent, both promised clean by the docstrings): (1) ideal_arc_coeffs_2d now guards v*v underflow (v=1e-200 previously -> ZeroDivisionError from G_2D/0; now clean ValueError) — physics.py:387-389; (2) ideal_parabola_2d now raises ValueError when the landing root x_land<=0 (below-floor + downward angle previously returned negative x_land and a descending linspace instead of the docstring's promised error) — physics.py:418-421. NOT FIXED (cross-file, reported for integrator): the 2D Magnus sign in acceleration_2d is -BM*(omega x v) (ay=-BM*omega_z*vx), i.e. backspin (omega_z>0, vx>0) gives DOWNWARD lift, contradicting the 3D magnus_force (+omega x v, upward) and SIMULATION_2D_PHYSICS.md §7 '力 ∝ ω×v' / §3 '后旋→升力向上'; the §3 formula text matches the code, so the doc is self-contradictory and the sign is duplicated in basketball_shot_2d.py dv() and experiment._dv2 — per PLAN.md this must be decided across all three files, not flipped unilaterally. Verification: python test_core.py 13/13 PASS, python test_collision.py 24/24 OK, python -m py_compile physics.py OK, python -c 'import physics' OK, python physics.py self-check exit 0; trajectory endpoint unchanged (landing t=1.462389, pos=[1.313492,0,0], vel=[3.978934,-7.771682,0] = physics.md §8.2); ideal_arc_coeffs_2d(2,51,7.9) a2 and ideal_parabola_2d(2,51,7.9) x_land=7.49952354721837 bit-identical before/after.
